---
name: Missing op or backend gap
about: An op brotensor does not have, or has on one backend but not another
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing:** the op (with its PyTorch or GGML equivalent, if there
is one), the dtypes, and which backends need it. docs/op-coverage.md lists
what exists per backend today.

**What needs it:** the model or library that would use it.
